technical-summary: libr3 selftest --pin-mw/--pin-nt pin the narrow int8 GEMM's wave and token-tile counts for --perfw8 sweeps; values the hooks would drop are refused and the pins in effect are printed. VTP37 notes record the wave-count sweep.
user-summary-candidate: Kernel self-test can pin the narrow int8 GEMM's launch shape for tuning sweeps.
